terminal_state_policy: 5-prime suites use 5prime_hydroxyl on residue 0; 3-prime suites use 3prime_hydroxyl on residue 1; the other residue is internally linked
frame_definition: upstream Tsukuba base frame; not a standard base-pair or X3DNA frame

interpretation_limit: This library contains boundary suites from six crystal structures of one 8-nt sequence. It supports only the observed boundary dinucleotides and does not establish cross-entry placement, general terminal chemistry, a complete RNA builder, or gap-closure performance.
